title: SlopSwipe: Skip AI Slop Videos
shortDescription: Auto swipe AI junk off your short video feed. Keyword filter, block list, undo.
tagline: Skip AI Slop in Shorts, TikTok and Reels

sections.title: Skip AI Slop in Shorts, TikTok and Reels
paragraphs: AI slop is flooding short-form video feeds: AI voiceover stories, fake animals, synthetic "news". SlopSwipe is an AI slop blocker for Android. Keep using the real YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Reels apps; when a video matches a rule you turned on, SlopSwipe swipes to the next one and records why, so a wrong skip is easy to undo. Nothing from your screen leaves your phone; no account needed.

sections.title: Popular Ways People Use SlopSwipe
bullets: Hide AI slop from your short video feed without quitting short videos
Block AI content farms and spam accounts by name, for good
Parental use: fewer fake AI videos for a child, parent or grandparent

sections.title: AI Video Detection by Transparent Rules
bullets: Platform AI labels: videos marked as AI-generated are skipped
Keyword and hashtag filter: AI hashtags or phrases like "AI story" in title or caption
Your own block list, plus a shared list of reported AI accounts that a person reviews
Every rule is visible in Settings and can be turned off

sections.title: Auto Swipe, AI Slop Blocker and One-Tap Undo
bullets: Auto-swipes to the next video when a rule matches, with a tunable delay
History shows why each video was skipped; mark a mistake there or add an Undo button after every skip
Allow list for creators you trust, block list for accounts you are done with; export and import lists
Sensitivity: Strict, Normal or Relaxed; light AI such as AI voiceover can be Skip, Hint or Ignore
Never acts on ads, comments, messages or any other app

sections.title: Schedule, Parent Mode, Widget and Rule Packs
bullets: Schedule stricter filtering at night or during work hours
Parent mode locks the settings behind a PIN
Home-screen widget with today's skips, Quick Settings tile to pause
Themed rule packs; pause for 30 minutes, until tomorrow or until you resume

sections.title: Screen Time, Doomscrolling Limits and Digital Wellbeing
bullets: How long you scrolled and how many AI videos were skipped today and this week
Daily limit, bedtime and focus time: a gentle reminder or a trip to the home screen
Clean feed streak with a share card that holds only numbers
Every limit has "Off for today"; nothing is forced on you

sections.title: Guides That Work Without Any Permission
paragraphs: Step-by-step guides for each platform's own AI settings, spotting AI videos yourself, and keeping the service alive on phones with aggressive battery savers.

sections.title: Privacy First, On-Device Only
bullets: Reads only on-screen text in Shorts, TikTok and Reels: title, caption, account name, hashtags, AI label
No screen recording, no screenshots, no upload of screen content, no login
"What we read" shows the last text read; crash reports and statistics are optional
No ads, no subscriptions

sections.title: Please note
bullets: SlopSwipe uses Android's accessibility service to read on-screen text and swipe up for you. It is not an assistive tool for people with disabilities and runs only after you read what it does and agree.
Unlabelled videos may slip through and a wrong one may occasionally be skipped; Undo fixes that. If a platform changes its layout, SlopSwipe stops and tells you. Android 8.0+.
YouTube, TikTok and Instagram are trademarks of their owners; SlopSwipe is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

sections.title: Something not working?
paragraphs: Wrong video skipped, or none at all? Email feedback@dapplebyte.com with your phone model and platform before leaving a review; most issues are fixed in the next update.
